description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). Price bars, newest last, at most 100: by default 5-minute bars for the session (today or `date`), or daily bars when `days` is more than 1 or interval is D. `interval` is 1m, 5m, 15m or D; `limit` (1 to 100) keeps the newest bars; `days` (up to 250) sets the daily window. The reply gives `from`, `to`, `returned` and `available` so you can page by date, and `latest` (the live price, its time and basis, as quantgeeks_get_last_price gives it).

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the most recent regular session.

days.description: Daily window in days (more than 1 selects daily bars).

limit.description: How many of the newest bars (default and maximum 100).

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to its 0DTE option root SPXW), SPY, QQQ, VIX.

name: quantgeeks_get_price_bars
title: Price bars
